findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) — RCE via Jinja2
findings.description: The /greet endpoint passes the 'name' GET parameter directly into a Jinja2 template without sanitization. An attacker can inject arbitrary Jinja2 expressions, escalating to full Remote Code Execution via Python's os.popen(). The flag was extracted from /tmp/flag on the server.

diagrams.title: Application Architecture — SSTI Demo (CTF)
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  Attacker["Attacker"] --> GrpEndpoint["GET /greet?name= (Jinja2 SSTI)"]
  GrpEndpoint --> FlaskApp["Flask App (Werkzeug 3.0.3 / Python 3.9.25)"]
  FlaskApp --> Jinja2["Jinja2 Template Engine"]
  Jinja2 --> OSPopen["os.popen() RCE"]
  OSPopen --> FS["/tmp/flag (CTF flag)"]
  FlaskApp --> HomeEndpoint["GET / (form page)"]
